abstract: Serum levels of alpha-fetoprotein and human chorionic gonadotropin were used in the management of 50 consecutive patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis. Of the 50 patients 36 had clinical or pathologic documentation of malignancy at some time during their treatment and 34 of these patients (94 per cent) had elevated levels of 1 or both of the markers. The marker(s) was elevated before lymphadenectomy in 9 of 15 patients (60 per cent) with clinical stage A or B disease wh had not been cured by orchiectomy. Among patients with pathologic stage B disease elevated marker levels before or after lymphadenectomy were of no prognostic significance. All of the patients with stage C disease had elevated marker(s) and the effectiveness of chemotherapy in destroying measurable disease generally was reflected in the marker levels.
abstract_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者50例を連続して治療し、その管理に血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値を用いた。50例中36例は治療中のいずれかの時点で臨床的または病理学的に悪性腫瘍が確認され、そのうち34例（94%）が1種類または両方のマーカーの上昇を示した。精巣摘除術後も治癒していない臨床病期A期またはB期の15例中9例（60%）では、リンパ節郭清前にマーカーが上昇していた。病理学的B期の患者では、リンパ節郭清の前後のマーカー上昇は予後的意義がなかった。病理学的C期の患者は全例でマーカーが上昇しており、化学療法による測定可能な病変の消失の効果は、一般にマーカー値に反映されていた。
